opportunities.opportunity_id: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)
opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: Up to £500,000 for research that addresses one or more of the priority questions outlined in our Strategic Review.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Proposals must address at least one of the priority questions and meet the assessment criteria. Proposals from individuals without formal employment or contractual relationship with the institution hosting the grant are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the priority questions outlined in our Strategic Review.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research proposals must contribute to understanding, public debate, policy and/or practice on tackling racial inequalities, discrimination and disadvantage. Proposals from individuals without formal employment or contractual relationship with the institution hosting the grant are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK.
